snippet.title: FEE3 2025: Absolution by ZessDynamite
snippet.description:
Absolution is a Fire Emblem fangame featuring several unique mechanics including a Tellius style skill system and a Paper Mario style cooking system. Other features include weapon crafting, personal skills, and an all-original soundtrack! Join Valentina as she seeks to right the wrongs of both the recent and ancient past on an adventure spanning multiple continents and 32 chapters.
https://feuniverse.us/t/lex-talionis-absolution-26-32-chapters/
